risks.proof: Video of a complete test: thread + bobbin + straight stitch and zigzag on fabric, showing tension results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven for correct stitching (worst case: needs adjustment/service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/manual/power components (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, foot pedal, power cord).
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out and labeled, plus close-ups of power cord and foot pedal; photo of manual cover/first page.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete accessories/manual (worst case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Exact model/variant and country-of-manufacture uncertainty affects value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating/model plate (usually underside/back) showing model/serial and 'Made in ...' text.

risks.risk: Electrical safety/condition (cord/plug/pedal) and reliability over time.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the rating/model plate (underside/back) showing model/serial and country of manufacture.
Send a short video of a full stitching test (threading + bobbin + straight stitch + zigzag) on fabric.
Send photos of every accessory and the manual (manual cover + first page), and close-ups of power cord + foot pedal.
response.reason: The seller’s reply asserts testing and completeness, but without new photos or a stitching/electrical video, those claims remain unverified remotely. To price safely, the exact model/country and verified working stitching performance are still missing.
